$comment: Migration number registry (BASE-12, docs/VERSIONING.md §6). Files are the source of truth for numbers already in use; this file only records numbers reserved by a track that has not merged yet, and numbers retired without a file. `npm run check:migrations` fails on duplicate numbers, on gaps not explained here, and (local) on files not registered in src-tauri/src/db.rs. Reserve numbers here in the same change as the track plan; when a reserved number ships, remove its entry; if it is abandoned, move it to `retired`.
